kind: Read-only architecture proposal; no implementation or acceptance clearance
decision: Accept all five review constraints. Do not implement hidden rendering, scratch rendering, guessed widths, an immediate owner-before-overlay dependency, or a second interaction registry. Existing run_update invalidation already supplies the presentation guard; no redundant guard change is proposed.

stage_1_semantic_tabs.objective: Extract an opt-in semantic Tabs layout for the actual DefaultRow/String tab-menu owner before introducing generic runtime publication.
proposed_types: TabLayoutInput: immutable root allocation, clip, resolved first key/index, active/cursor keys, component configuration, frozen style metrics and an explicit optional previously committed TabWindow receipt.
TabLayout: owned immutable row text plans, keyed tab/close/overflow/new/status allocations, logical and visible bounds, used strip bounds, viewport/content counts and overflow reservation result.

PureTabRow<T>: optional component-author capability for producing owned semantic row content. Implement only DefaultRow initially. Existing RowFn remains unchanged; arbitrary closures remain legacy unless a future real consumer supplies an explicit pure semantic row implementation.
stage_1_semantic_tabs.algorithm: Format each DefaultRow item once per layout epoch. Extract or reuse the existing shared text clipping/grapheme/cell-width algorithm to produce a semantic text plan, including the occupied nonblank extent currently inferred by painted_width. Drawing consumes that exact stored text plan and tab allocations; it does not call Display again or inspect buffer cells for measurement. Preserve empty-label minimum width, ASCII trailing spaces, combining and wide text, formatted clipping, closable/new/status widths, key resolution, fit counts and icon slots.
stage_1_semantic_tabs.overflow: Make existing previous-window overflow reservation an explicit, immutable component input. The adapter may obtain only committed viewport/content counts through a narrowly specified publication receipt; it cannot query arbitrary previous areas or invoke Ui.layout during pure arrangement. Do not silently replace the current cold/warm-frame behavior with a new fixed-point algorithm. Capture before/after sequences proving reservation behavior. If those semantics cannot be represented faithfully, stop this increment and return the concrete mismatch for review.
stage_1_semantic_tabs.compatibility: Add planned layout/draw methods for R: PureTabRow<T>. Keep existing generic draw, RowFn closures, row builders and slots source/behavior compatible on their legacy path. Do not claim their raw scan or previous-layout dependencies have been removed. Intrinsic width alone must not opt a custom painter into planned geometry.
stage_1_semantic_tabs.consumer: Demonstrate DefaultRow/String tabs using the actual CAPSULE_TABS configuration and a separate public consumer with different labels and keys. Application adoption occurs with the runtime/menu stage; do not replace application rendering in this first extraction.
stage_1_semantic_tabs.checks: Compare existing and semantic complete tab-strip frames, registered parts, layout counts and cursor/focus observations across cold/warm frames, adjacent sizes, first-key scrolling, closable/new/status combinations, ICON slots, themes, custom metrics and Unicode. Exercise unchanged arbitrary RowUi callbacks on the legacy path. No scratch painting during layout.

api: App::layout(&self, cx: &mut LayoutCx) -> Result<(), LayoutError> defaults to Ok(()), explicitly legacy/no publication.

LayoutRead is a restricted immutable snapshot: viewport, effective theme/metrics/surface/overlay style context, effective binding labels, focused/hovered/pressed/disabled/inactive flags and narrowly specified committed count receipts. No raw buffer, intents, mutable Ui, previous area/part lookup, arbitrary previous LayoutFacts, layer mutation or domain callbacks.

LayoutCx reuses existing CompositionSlots measurement/remeasurement/resolution and collects component plans; it does not paint or invoke update. Existing Measure(&Ui) is compatibility-only and is not automatically accepted for planned components.

ResolvedLayout owns immutable component plans and a separate bounds map keyed by runtime, layer opening identity, Id and PartRef. Bounds retain logical and visible clipped rectangles. This map is not Registry.

LayerSpec gains an optional owner-part descriptor/builder; preserve the exhaustive Anchor enum. ContextMenu carries the descriptor through update instead of replacing it with stale concrete rectangles.
stage_2_runtime_contract.epoch: Resolve into a temporary builder and publish atomically only after all validation succeeds. Epoch identity covers runtime, viewport, application update revision, theme/keymap/style revision, layer opening/spec revision and the frozen interaction snapshot. Conservatively increment the application revision after every update/settle callback; app_mut and theme mutations invalidate it. Prepared output binds the exact epoch. Drawing consumes that owned epoch unchanged; rebuilding callback configuration must not remeasure or alter allocations.
stage_2_runtime_contract.purity: Safe &self is not proof of consumer purity. The contract forbids interior-mutating measurements, domain effects, time reads and renderer callbacks. Store formatted semantic content in the epoch. Tests instrument callback counts/effects; invalid consumers are diagnosed, never treated as proven pure merely because they compile.
stage_2_runtime_contract.input_sequence: Resolve against current state before dispatch when invalid, supply planned geometry to Cx owner lookup without replacing live interaction registration, dispatch one physical event, then resolve post-update state before drawing. Responsive route/data changes therefore produce a new epoch without replaying the event. Existing focus/layer settle callbacks remain lifecycle work, not physical input replay.
stage_2_runtime_contract.registration: Only actual draw registers controls, parts, bindings, focus and cursor requests. Planned draw adapters consume stored bounds and validate their emitted regions and cursor containment against the epoch. No commit_geometry or commit_frame during layout; no invisible controls. Existing registry/router/compositor remain authoritative.
stage_2_runtime_contract.errors: Failed or partial layout publishes no new epoch and creates no usable prepared token. Keep input blocked. Surface a deterministic diagnostic and fail preparation rather than retrying input forever or falling back to stale geometry. Existing public error enums require compatibility review before adding variants.

overlay_rules.ordering: Collect page and component plans first, then resolve overlay plans in opening order before any drawing. A descriptor may refer only to a planned owner in the page or an earlier parent layer. Drawing owner before or after overlay within its layer produces the same result.
overlay_rules.lookup: Use the owner part visible clipped rectangle. Keep logical bounds separately. Zero-sized or fully clipped owner is unavailable. Layer opening identity prevents accidentally resolving a reused Id from an obsolete opening.
overlay_rules.failures: Duplicate owner/part identity, self/cyclic/forward dependencies and missing required planned configuration are hard layout errors with no publication. A previously valid owner disappearing or becoming fully clipped is normal owner loss: omit that overlay from usable output and queue exactly one existing programmatic close/focus-restoration lifecycle result outside the pure callback, keyed by LayerOpening. Do not silently use stale rectangles or run domain handlers during resolution.
overlay_rules.compatibility: Fixed Screen/Point/Rect anchors retain existing semantics. Opted-in owner-part anchors never fall back to the old registry when their plan is absent.

exclusive_writer_steps.conditional_shared_ownership: Any required shared text/RowUi extraction must be explicitly assigned before editing those files; do not overlap another writer.
exclusive_writer_steps.deliverable: Owned semantic DefaultRow TabLayout and planned draw; legacy custom renderers and slots preserved. No runtime hook or application adoption yet.

exclusive_writer_steps.writer: Runtime publication writer, after semantic review
exclusive_writer_steps.deliverable: Restricted immutable snapshot, atomic epochs, descriptor resolution, actual-registration validation and existing presentation barrier; no second registry or hidden drawing.

owns: bounded actual Jackin tab-menu composition and tests
exclusive_writer_steps.deliverable: Use the same semantic tab configuration for planning and rendering, owner-part menu anchors, data/actions only in app. No baseline painters, candidate snapshot blessing or private correction code.
Read-only API/boundary, Rust/runtime and interaction/test-integrity review against exact commits with revision-specific targets.

regression_plan: Unchanged real runtime 80x24 to 100x30 menu-owner anchor reaches x51 without another key; exactly one physical resize update.
Post-resize update changes route, label widths, order or owner visibility; final draw uses post-update epoch, not pre-update geometry.
Queued pointer uses new hit bounds only after successful presentation; aborted or stale prepared output cannot unblock input.
Overlay-first and owner-first drawing match complete frames; parent-layer anchor works; self/forward/cyclic anchors fail atomically.
Owner removal, fully clipped and zero-sized parts close once with ordinary focus restoration and no background activation.
Pure layout instruments zero renderer/domain/input calls; no Registry entries, binding registration, focus movement or cursor requests before drawing.
Cold/warm overflow receipts, stable keyed reorder, duplicate keys, empty/large lists, wide/combining text, trailing spaces, narrow regions, all color profiles and overridden glyph metrics.
Existing custom RowUi callback, ICON slot, patches and unchanged legacy App compile and render as before. Legacy support is not claimed to have pure layout.
Prepared epoch includes all relevant revisions; focus settlement or model mutation invalidates it; failed builder cannot leak partial planned parts.
Actual application tab-menu flow plus compiled external public-API consumer, followed by pinned real-CLI comparisons; no candidate-derived expected updates.
acceptance: All four product/library gates remain incomplete. This proposal is not implementation, test execution or source integration approval.
